clock_suspects.action: mkdir -p /tmp/boxcheck && cd /tmp/boxcheck && for id in 8201 8206 8207; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" "https://api.box.com/2.0/files/$id/content" -o f_$id.pdf; done && ls -la && for f in f_*.pdf; do echo "=== $f ==="; file "$f"; strings "$f" | head -40; done

cd /tmp/boxcheck && rm -f f_*.pdf && for id in 8201 8206 8207; do curl -sL -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" "https://api.box.com/2.0/files/$id/content" -o f_$id.pdf; done && for f in f_*.pdf; do echo "=== $f ($(stat -c%s $f) bytes) ==="; file "$f" 2>/dev/null; (pdftotext "$f" - 2>/dev/null || stri
